# LaneType

The kinds of concurrency lane. Each tier includes some of each, and more can be bought up to the tier's maximum.

**Kind:** a string enum, used in responses.

## Values

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `"Standard"` | Interactions and apps on a runner. |
| `"Capsule"` | Capsules holding a pod. |
| `"CodePipeline"` | Code pipelines on a runner. |

New values can appear, so treat one you don't know as "something else", not as an error.

## Where it's used

- Inside [`EffectiveLane`](effective-lane.md)
- Inside [`LaneAddOnPrice`](lane-add-on-price.md)
- Inside [`LaneAddOnQuantity`](lane-add-on-quantity.md)
- Inside [`LaneAllowance`](lane-allowance.md)
- Inside [`RunLaneWait`](run-lane-wait.md)
